extracted.name: Whole30 Easy Balsamic Vinaigrette
extracted.description: Quick and easy balsamic dressing using 5 simple ingredients is great for any salad and fits into the Whole30 program.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine olive oil, mustard, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a Mason jar or container with a tight-fitting lid; cover tightly with the lid and shake vigorously until thickened, about 2 minutes. Taste dressing and adjust flavor with salt and pepper.
